name: HiveTrace
summary: Honey supply-chain traceability protocol with role-based workspaces for apiaries, laboratories, processors, and distributors, paired with a consumer QR verification interface.

name: StegDetector
summary: Image steganography triage web application combining deterministic image forensics (LSB bit-plane slicing, Shannon entropy, chi-square distribution) with optional local or cloud LLM forensic reviews.
notes: Generates visual bit-plane slices, RGB histograms, and LSB density heatmaps with deterministic rule-based fallback.

name: E2EE Messaging
summary: Terminal-based end-to-end encrypted messaging system implementing forward secrecy through ephemeral X25519 Diffie-Hellman key exchanges and AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.
notes: Relay server only forwards ciphertexts; verified via packet inspection that plaintext never hits the wire.
